note: Manual visual review (2026-10-18) of generated PNG previews against retained originals. Observations only; no geometry or codes were derived from these reviews.

reviews.observations: Title '2022 Redistricting Goshen County', dated March 31, 2022. Labeled precincts 1-1, 2-1, 7-2, 7-3, 8-1, 8-2, 9-1, 13-1, 15-1, 16-1, 17-1, 18-1, 20-1 with HD/SD labels. Footer: 'for visualization purposes only. Please check with the Goshen County Clerk to verify district information.'
Same title and March 31, 2022 date over imagery of Torrington; labels 7-1, 7-2 and 7-3. With the county map, all 14 codes of the 2024 result rows and the 2026 SOS roster appear.

'Precinct Map Converse County', footer 'Redistricting 2022'. Rural precincts 1-1, 2-2, 3-1, 4-4, 6-6, 7-7, 8-8, 10-10, 13-13, 20-20 with SD/HD labels; Douglas and Glenrock precincts are on the city maps. Layout agrees with the render-inferred labels in previews/56009-converse-terragis-wfs-precinct-poly.png (10-10 north-west, 13-13 north-east, 20-20 centre, 3-1 south, 6-6 south-west).

'Albany County Precincts', dated 4/18/2024. Rural precincts 14-0 and 46-0 subdivided into polling-place/fire-district parts (14-0-RR-NF, 14-0-S-F, 46-0-C-F, 46-0-H-F, 46-0-FG-F ...), matching the 'name' values of the Albany GIS layer; legend explains the key (House District - Ward - Polling Place - Fire/Non-fire).

'Carbon County Election Precincts' with legend names such as RAWLINS 1-2-1, SARATOGA 11-2 OUTSIDE, ENCAMPMENT 12-1-1 OUTSIDE (the same naming as the Terra GIS precincts2022 layer), house-district outlines and precinct-split hatching; no date printed in the visible title block.
